Acceptance Criteria: Live Tank A / Flow In reads and Fill / Discharge valve writes respond correctly.
Evidence / Actual Result: Verified during live Modbus operation at 192.168.0.100:502.

Acceptance Criteria: Valid START progresses through startup states and reaches RUNNING without active trip.
Evidence / Actual Result: Repeated runs reached STABILIZING then RUNNING.

Acceptance Criteria: STOP executes controlled shutdown and returns system to STOPPED.
E-STOP immediately latches emergency trip and forces safe state.
Evidence / Actual Result: E-STOP produced TRIPPED with trip reason E-STOP.

Acceptance Criteria: START must not restart process while a trip / E-STOP is active.
Evidence / Actual Result: START command issued while TRIPPED; state remained TRIPPED.

Acceptance Criteria: Tank A <= LL setpoint during transfer causes emergency trip.
Evidence / Actual Result: Tank A reached 0; state changed to TRIPPED; reset succeeded after level recovery.

Acceptance Criteria: Tank B >= HH requests controlled shutdown, not emergency trip.
Evidence / Actual Result: Repeatedly verified; HH preempted early tests before model tuning.

Acceptance Criteria: Pressure >= trip setpoint causes immediate emergency trip and latches.
Evidence / Actual Result: Functional trip path verified using temporary 5.0 bar commissioning threshold; production value restored to 6.0 bar.

Acceptance Criteria: Loss of effective transfer flow while RUNNING trips after configured persistence delay (~5 s).
Evidence / Actual Result: Transfer Fault ON at 17:55:53; TRIPPED at 17:55:59 with PERSISTENT NO FLOW.

Acceptance Criteria: Flow imbalance above warning threshold creates warning without premature trip.
Persistent flow imbalance + pressure-drop condition causes latched emergency trip.
Evidence / Actual Result: Verified by automated commissioning sequence after race-condition hardening.

Acceptance Criteria: Low flow ratio + pressure-drop signature is detected.
Evidence / Actual Result: Verified; blockage also used to validate high-pressure path.

Acceptance Criteria: Injected outlet-flow sensor bias is visible and detection reacts.
Injected pressure sensor bias increases apparent pressure drop and is observable.
Evidence / Actual Result: Fault produced increased Delta-P while flow remained approximately unchanged.

Acceptance Criteria: RESET must be rejected while the transfer fault remains active.
Evidence / Actual Result: RESET attempted while TRANSFER fault remained ON; system stayed TRIPPED.

Acceptance Criteria: After hazard removal, RESET clears latched trip and returns safe STOPPED state.
Evidence / Actual Result: Transfer Fault OFF -> RESET -> STOPPED, trip clear, alarms clear.

Acceptance Criteria: Final state must be STOPPED with no trip, alarm, or simulated fault.
Evidence / Actual Result: 18:02:25: STOPPED, TankA=557, TankB=100, Flow=0/0, Pin=1.2, Trip=OFF, Alarms=0, Faults=NONE.

Acceptance Criteria: Unavailable valve feedback should block startup / relevant permissive.
Evidence / Actual Result: Not executed: current Factory I/O scene has no real valve-health feedback; availability is virtual.
